statement: This ledger holds only CURRENTLY ACTIVE claims. It deliberately does not atomize the historical repository. Record shape is §37 verbatim. The status vocabulary ACTIVE | OPEN | SUPERSEDED is not given by the manual and is fixed here.
resolution_method: None required; §0.1 forbids exhaustive historical atomization.
acceptance_or_evidence: manual §50 Phase B step 8: Create a CURRENT claim ledger; do not atomize every historical sentence.

source_ref: docs/PHASE8_SALVAGE_HANDOFF.md §6; docs/HAMILTONIAN_CHESS_META_GOAL.md §3; manual §6.36, §25 Gate 6, Appendix D
statement: RSTAR_NOT_IDENTIFIED. No representation-only R_ONLY search has produced a candidate meeting the RSTAR_0_1 evidence tier. No RSTAR claim may be made.
resolution_method: Only an R_ONLY search plus Gate 6 confirmation with at least two meaningfully distinct Solver families (manual §25 Gate 6, Appendix D) can retire this sentinel.
acceptance_or_evidence: Standing sentinel, unchanged by the Phase 8 salvage commit; Phase 8 created no sentinel and retired none.

statement: GAME_R_INSTRUMENT_NOT_QUALIFIED (operational). The Game-R micro-probe instrument has not been qualified. Under the 2026-09-08 mission reset this is a statement about one assay, not a blocker on the programme.
resolution_method: Qualification under a frozen preregistration on the substrate the assay will actually run on (manual §3.2).
acceptance_or_evidence: docs/HAMILTONIAN_CHESS_META_GOAL.md §3: the failure of a micro-probe instrument is no longer a blocker on the project.

statement: V7_PARTIALLY_VALID_INSTRUMENT_CONFOUNDED (scientific). The V7 instrument is partially valid and confounded; its findings stand as recorded and are not reinterpreted.
resolution_method: Not resolvable retrospectively (manual §3.3: evidence immutability, corrections are additive).
acceptance_or_evidence: Forensic audit findings stand; nothing in the V1-V7 record is retracted.

statement: TRAINING_LANGUAGE_V0_BASELINE. TRAINING_LANGUAGE_V0 stands as a released baseline artifact, not as a demonstrated improvement over any incumbent.
resolution_method: A superiority claim would require the manual §25 Gate 5/6 evidence tier.

statement: Maximum reasoning horizon anywhere in the committed repository is 1. Every environment in arena/environments/ is a single-step probe, and the only CanonicalTrajectory construction in the package (arena/tasks/generators/world_v0.py:507) passes a one-element tuple.
resolution_method: Superseded only by building a verifier-backed multi-step VerifiedTask world (manual §17, §47 Steps 5-6).
acceptance_or_evidence: Verified 2026-09-08 by direct code inspection; recorded in two independent documents. CONSEQUENCE: nothing committed can measure a horizon effect, so CLM-UNKNOWN-HORIZON-031 cannot be addressed on the committed substrate.

statement: The eight registered seed codecs are genome-blind: mutating each of the 14 gene families to every legal value (44 one-gene variants) changes 0 of 44 rendered outputs. The one genome-driven codec, GenomePhenotypeLanguage, changes the bytes on 24 of 44 variants and loses no round-trip.
resolution_method: Widen the gene-to-byte map so the genome can change payload structure, not only surface (manual §10, docs/LANGUAGE_META_GENOME_V0.md §1.5).
acceptance_or_evidence: Verified 2026-09-08. grep -rn self.genome arena/languages/*/__init__.py returns nothing. docs/HAMILTONIAN_CHESS_REPO_REMAP.md §3.2 records 22-24 of 44 for the phenotype codec; the META_MDP figure of 24 is the one used here.

statement: L3_JSON_AST and L6_GRAPH_TRIPLES share 98.6 percent of their state bytes via spans of at least 40 characters at stratum P20; L0_STRUCTURED_ENGLISH versus L3_JSON_AST reaches a 0.82 sequence-similarity ratio. The eight seed surfaces are not eight independent points in design space.
resolution_method: Behavioural-descriptor diversity gate at archive admission (docs/LONG_HORIZON_FITNESS_V0.md §3.3 D4); grammar families may not alias one another (manual §10.6).
acceptance_or_evidence: 6 strata x 8 surfaces x 28 arm pairs, e1_coverage_max_direction = 0.9860. CONSEQUENCE: any search treating the eight seeds as a diverse founding population starts from a narrower space than it thinks.

statement: The Arena canonical schema maps 0 of 368 real Lean proof states losslessly. 292 states (79.3 percent) map with loss and 76 (20.7 percent) cannot be mapped at all.
resolution_method: Manual §17.4 permits backend-native truth; Omega_L must then be defined over the backend-native envelope. A canonical schema bump re-hashes every state in the project and is forbidden without an ADR and migration policy (manual §44.2).

statement: Raw pretty-printed Lean state string equality scores 40.6 percent where real semantic agreement is 98.1 percent. A string-comparing verifier would reject 59.4 percent of correct steps.
resolution_method: Truth stays with the backend state identity; string comparison may exist only as a labelled descriptive statistic, never as a verifier (manual §17.3).
acceptance_or_evidence: Measured during the trajectory-arena audit; the divergence is scope-dependent rendering, univ versus Finset.univ.

statement: The LeanDojo benchmark 4 random/train.json split holds 118,517 records, 59,557 with traced_tactics and 250,814 steps; 1,605 theorems have a reference proof of at least 20 recorded tactics, and the maximum is 128.
resolution_method: None; this is a count. NOTE under manual §17.6: a 20-tactic reference proof is an ObservedTraceLength, NOT a required reasoning horizon and NOT a MinimalProofLength.
acceptance_or_evidence: Independently re-verified 2026-09-08. The random/{val,test} and novel_premises/{val,test} splits sit in the same tree, are SEALED, and were not opened.

statement: The prior-art audit returns NOVEL_ONLY_IN_COMBINATION, and that verdict is binding. Publishing the architecture alone would be LARGELY_COVERED_BY_PRIOR_ART. The project may not claim to have invented a mathematical DSL, to have introduced the idea that representation matters, to have introduced searching over representations, or to have introduced agents inventing symbols.
resolution_method: Manual §5.7: the defensible research object remains a novelty CANDIDATE, not an unqualified claim, and must be earned as a result.
acceptance_or_evidence: Audit dated 2026-09-08. Two controls follow and are binding: a compute- and sampling-matched control, and enforced information parity.

statement: A useful mathematical cognition language or workspace should preserve or increase its advantage as reasoning dependency length and horizon increase.
resolution_method: Manual §23: evaluate candidate deltas across horizons and test whether Delta_L(20) exceeds Delta_L(1) or an analogous pattern holds, WITHOUT assuming it must. The metric must be preregistered: under pure compounding with zero interaction the absolute accuracy gap is unimodal in horizon and can be made to read either way by post-hoc bucket choice.
acceptance_or_evidence: NOT ESTABLISHED. No agent may convert this to KNOWN_FACT without an evidence record (manual §37).

statement: Whether any practically useful language or representation effect exists at all, under the declared search, models, tasks and compute.
resolution_method: Pilot 1 under a frozen preregistered manifest (manual §41). NO_PRACTICALLY_USEFUL_LANGUAGE_EFFECT_FOUND is a permitted and reportable outcome (manual §4.3, §43).
acceptance_or_evidence: OPEN. This is a SCIENTIFIC UNKNOWN (manual §2.2 B), not a specification defect, and MUST NOT be converted to an ENGINEERING_DECISION to keep coding (manual §37).

statement: Whether any language effect interacts with reasoning horizon beyond what per-step compounding already predicts.
resolution_method: Requires a verifier-backed multi-step world (currently absent, CLM-FACT-HORIZON-010) plus a preregistered estimand. The two forms compounding cannot explain are rank reversal across horizon and super-compounding of the per-step gap.

statement: Whether the bounded meta-genome produces a landscape that is searchable, in the §6.23 sense that observations from previously evaluated candidates predict useful future candidate modifications better than a null or random search process.
resolution_method: Manual §31: measure valid-neighbor rate, beneficial-mutation rate, parent-child fitness correlation, gene-effect directional consistency, local ruggedness, rank stability, novelty coverage, surrogate predictability and epistasis frequency. A formal decision rule is preregistered only after Pilot 1 supplies variance estimates.
acceptance_or_evidence: OPEN. Manual §31: do not claim a searchable landscape merely because one mutant wins. LANDSCAPE_NOT_ESTABLISHED and LANDSCAPE_TOO_RUGGED_FOR_LOCAL_SEARCH are permitted outcomes (manual §43).

statement: InterventionClass does not exist anywhere in this repository. grep -rn for InterventionClass or intervention_class across arena/, tests/ and docs/ returns zero matches as of 2026-09-08.
contradictions: manual §6.26 requires every candidate comparison to declare one
manual §40.5 makes truthful intervention classification an HC-V0 success criterion
resolution_method: Implement the eight-member enum, require it on LanguageCandidate (manual §12.1) and on every fitness record, and enforce DEAD_UNDECLARED_INTERVENTION (manual §12.4).
acceptance_or_evidence: Direct grep, 2026-09-08. This is a CONFORMANCE GAP against the manual, recorded rather than papered over.

statement: No VerifiedTask object exists in code. grep -rn VerifiedTask across arena/ and tests/ returns zero matches; only VerifiedTrajectory is implemented.
resolution_method: Implement the §17.1 field set with a terminal_predicate, action_interface and verifier_adapter. Until then HC-V0 runs in TRAJECTORY_REPLAY and autonomous long-horizon solving is explicitly blocked (manual §40.3), sentinel META_GAME_BLOCKED_BY_INTERACTIVE_TRAJECTORY_WORLD.
acceptance_or_evidence: Direct grep, 2026-09-08, over the worktree including the untracked arena/trajectory/ package.
